title: Publish a self-consistent machine contract bundle
objective: Public contract files and examples actually describe deployed operations.
outcome: Old clients receive supported compatibility or a typed version error, not a silently different response shape. Fetch/compile the actual served schema closure; HTML fallback for a schema URL fails. Exactly the advertised tools and versions exist; the agent guide does not publish stale generation labels. All eight actual response envelopes validate against the served schemas. Protocol success and scientific-result states remain separate. A successful tool envelope is not a completed research task. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Version the changed input/output contracts
commits.instructions: Add accepted field/context changes additively where possible and document incompatible versions. Preserve old contract IDs and explicit migration behavior.
commits.verification: Old clients receive supported compatibility or a typed version error, not a silently different response shape.

commits.subject: Publish all transitive schema references
commits.instructions: Build a self-contained contract manifest and serve every referenced schema as JSON. Keep same-origin routing and typed missing-file behavior.
